class.name: Z80Node
class.brief_description: Complete, cycle-accurate Z80 CPU emulator with I/O callbacks and step debugger support.
class.description:
[Z80Node] is a GDExtension that wraps the [url=https://github.com/floooh/chips]floooh/chips[/url] Z80 emulator and exposes it to GDScript. It maintains 64 KB of internal RAM, 256 I/O input/output ports, and an accurate tick-based execution engine. [br][br] [b]Typical usage (50 Hz MSX frame loop):[/b] [codeblock] func _physics_process(_delta): vdp_status |= 0x80 # assert vsync flag cpu.trigger_int(0xFF) # raise /INT pin cpu.execute_cycles(71591) # ~3.58 MHz / 50 Hz [/codeblock] [b]Step debugger:[/b] [codeblock] # execute exactly one instruction cpu.execute_instruction() var pc = cpu.get_instr_pc()
# step over a CALL or LDIR (run until next instruction address) var info = Z80Dasm.disasm(func(a): return cpu.mem_read(a), pc) cpu.execute_until_pc(pc + info["length"], 100000) [/codeblock] [b]Interrupt lifecycle (MSX VDP example):[/b] [codeblock] # GDScript port-in callback func _on_port_in(port: int) -> int: if port == 0x99: # VDP status read cpu.clear_int() # VDP releases /INT after status read return 0x80 # bit 7 = vsync flag active return 0xFF [/codeblock]

method.name: load_binary
method.description: Copies [param data] into internal RAM starting at [param base_addr]. Clamps to 64 KB boundary. Ideal for loading ROM images.

method.name: get_memory
method.description: Returns a full 65536-byte copy of current RAM. Useful for snapshots or debugging.

method.name: set_memory
method.description: Replaces the entire 64 KB RAM with [param data]. [param data] must be exactly 65536 bytes.

method.name: mem_read
method.description: Reads one byte (0–255) from RAM at [param addr]. Address wraps at 0xFFFF.

method.name: mem_write
method.description: Writes one byte [param val] to RAM at [param addr].

method.name: execute_cycles
method.description: Runs the CPU for [param n] T-states. Because the Z80 never breaks mid-instruction, the actual number of cycles executed may slightly exceed [param n]. Returns the actual number of T-states executed. [br][br]For a 3.58 MHz MSX running at 50 Hz, pass [code]71591[/code].

method.name: execute_cycles_with_breakpoints
method.description: Runs the CPU for up to [param n] T-states. Monitors M1/RD cycles. If [method get_instr_pc] matches any address in [param breakpoints], execution stops immediately and the method returns [code]-1[/code]. Otherwise, it returns the total number of T-states executed.

method.name: execute_instruction
method.description: Executes exactly one complete Z80 instruction (all its T-states). Returns the number of T-states consumed. Use this for single-step debugging. [br][br]After this call, [method get_instr_pc] returns the address of the [i]next[/i] instruction to be executed.

method.name: execute_until_pc
method.description: Executes instructions until [method get_instr_pc] equals [param target_pc] or [param max_instrs] instructions have been executed (safety limit). Returns the number of instructions executed. [br][br]Use this to implement [b]step-over[/b]: set [param target_pc] to [code]current_pc + instruction_length[/code] so that CALL, LDIR, DJNZ etc. are executed as a single step from the debugger's perspective.

method.name: reset
method.description: Performs a hardware reset of the CPU (clears PC, SP, interrupt state, and internal pins). RAM contents are preserved.

method.name: trigger_int
method.description: Asserts the /INT pin. The CPU will acknowledge the interrupt after the current instruction completes (if IFF1=1). [param bus_data] is placed on the data bus during the IORQ+M1 acknowledge cycle (use [code]0xFF[/code] for MSX IM1 mode). [br][br]The /INT pin remains asserted until [method clear_int] is called (e.g. when the ISR reads the VDP status register).

method.name: trigger_nmi
method.description: Asserts the /NMI pin. The CPU jumps to address [code]0x0066[/code] regardless of IFF1. The pin is automatically cleared after the NMI is acknowledged.

method.name: clear_int
method.description: De-asserts the /INT pin. Call this from the port-in callback when the peripheral (e.g. VDP) releases the interrupt line — typically when the ISR reads the VDP status register (port [code]0x99[/code] on MSX).

method.name: get_registers
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] with the current CPU register state. Keys: [code]PC[/code], [code]SP[/code], [code]AF[/code], [code]BC[/code], [code]DE[/code], [code]HL[/code], [code]IX[/code], [code]IY[/code], [code]AF2[/code], [code]BC2[/code], [code]DE2[/code], [code]HL2[/code], [code]I[/code], [code]R[/code], [code]IFF1[/code], [code]IFF2[/code], [code]IM[/code]. [br][br][b]Note:[/b] [code]PC[/code] here reflects the internal [code]_cpu.pc[/code] which is already incremented past the opcode fetch. Use [method get_instr_pc] to get the real address of the current instruction.

method.name: set_registers
method.description: Sets any subset of CPU registers from [param regs]. Only keys present in the dictionary are applied; others are left unchanged. Accepts the same keys as [method get_registers]. [br][br]If [code]PC[/code] is present it is applied last via [code]z80_prefetch()[/code] so the pin state is updated correctly. [br][br]Example — initialise to a captured MSX state: [codeblock] cpu.set_registers({ "AF": 0x0124, "AF2": 0x3420, "BC": 0x0001, "BC2": 0x04F3, "DE": 0x4122, "DE2": 0x550C, "HL": 0x4004, "HL2": 0x4122, "IX": 0x4122, "IY": 0x0124, "SP": 0xF08E, "I": 0x00, "R": 0x04, "IFF1": 0, "IFF2": 0, "IM": 1, "PC": 0x4122, }) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_pc
method.description: Sets the Program Counter to [param addr] and updates the internal pin state via [code]z80_prefetch()[/code]. Equivalent to [code]set_registers({"PC": addr})[/code].

method.name: get_instr_pc
method.description: Returns the address of the instruction currently on the bus (M1/T2 address bus). This is the correct PC value to display in a debugger and to pass to a disassembler, because [code]get_registers()["PC"][/code] is already +1 past the opcode fetch.

method.name: set_port_in_callback
method.description: Registers a [Callable] that is invoked on every [code]IN[/code] instruction. Signature: [code]func(port: int) -> int[/code]. The returned value (0–255) is placed on the data bus. [br][br]If no callback is set, the static [method set_port_in] array is used instead.

method.name: set_port_out_callback
method.description: Registers a [Callable] that is invoked on every [code]OUT[/code] instruction. Signature: [code]func(port: int, value: int) -> void[/code].

method.name: set_mem_write_callback
set_port_in
method.description: Sets the static input value for [param port]. Used when no port-in callback is registered.

method.name: get_port_out
method.description: Returns the last value written by the CPU to [param port] via [code]OUT[/code].

method.name: get_ports_in
method.description: Returns all 256 input port values as a [PackedByteArray].

method.name: get_ports_out
method.description: Returns all 256 output port values as a [PackedByteArray].
